title: Septinsular
summary: SEPTIN'SULAR, adjective [Latin septum, seven, and insula, isle.] Consisting of seven isles; as the septinsular republic of the Ionian isles.

inlines.v: SEPTIN'SULAR, adjective [Latin septum, seven, and insula, isle.] Consisting of seven isles; as the septinsular republic of the Ionian isles.
